fusions.name: Skittering Rush
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt and move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trampling Wave
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Easy Canter
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: When you run out of stamina, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
